event: Determine the speaker's location (left, right, or back) relative to a robot standing by the white recessed fireplace and facing the wooden china cabinet, when the speech topic 'offering the listener's coffee' occurs.

sounding_object.description: A person with long dark brown hair, wearing a black short-sleeved crop top, light blue jeans, and a black belt. They are barefoot and initially wearing glasses, which they later remove. They are holding a smartphone at times.

reference_object.description: A white recessed fireplace with a dark wooden mantel. It has a round mirror with a dark frame hanging above it. During the video, there is a garland of small orange carrot decorations on the mantel. The fireplace opening is dark.

facing_object.description: A tall, dark brown wooden china cabinet with glass doors on the upper section, displaying white dishware. The lower section has solid wooden doors. It is located in an adjacent room, visible through a wide archway.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the white recessed fireplace and facing the wooden china cabinet, when the speech topic: "offering the listener's coffee" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
